descs: The weapon's muzzle flash and noise generation is reduced, and the player no longer appears on the minimap when firing. In exchange, the weapon's damage falls off 20 meters sooner, and bullet velocity is reduced by 15%.
A laser sight increases the user's hipfire accuracy by 33%.

The rail mounted Darklight Flashlight can illuminate hostile cloaked infiltrators and dark areas but the light can give away your position.

The light can be turned on and off with Toggle Attachment.
A compensator redirects gases upward, reducing vertical recoil by 30%, and increasing hipfire cone of fire by 15%. The added sound pressure causes the player to show on the minimap 35m farther away.
A flash suppressor makes the shooter less visible to the enemy, but increases the range at which you appear on enemy minimaps by 15 meters.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 4 rounds, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
A forward grip increases control of the weapon, reducing horizontal recoil by 25%, but increases equip time by 0.15 sec.
An angled forward grip reduces the vertical recoil of the first shot in a burst by 60%, but increases the side to side recoil of a weapon by 10%.
Soft Point Ammunition increases the weapon's maximum damage range by 5 meters, but reduces its projectile velocity by 10%.
High Velocity Ammunition increases the weapon's projectile velocity by 10% and minimum damage range by 20 meters, but reduces the weapon's maximum damage range by 2 meters.
This shortened barrel reduces cone of fire bloom by 40% when firing from the hip, and increases vertical recoil by 20% while aiming down sights.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 5 rounds, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
KCAP ammunition removes the legshot damage penalty, and increases damage to the leg area by 20%, but decreases headshot damage by 50%.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 6 rounds, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
A comfort grip reduces the time it takes to swap to the weapon by 30%, reduces horizontal recoil by 20%, but increases vertical recoil by 20%.
The mobile prediction laser reduces vertical and horizontal recoil when fired from the hip by 60%.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 2 rounds, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
The weapon now fires an accurate, high-velocity slug dealing 450 damage, falling off to 300 at the weapon's minimum damage range.
A smart-choke tightens pellet spread by 40% when firing while aimed, but widens pellet spread by 20% when firing from the hip.
Replaces the standard buckshot with dart-like flechettes that triple the maximum and minimum damage falloff range, but reduce the number of pellets fired per shot by 1.
Increases magazine size by 5 rounds, but increases hipfire cone of fire by 20%.
The straight-pull bolt allows the sniper to chamber another round while aiming down sights.
An advanced on-board computer compensates for the minor movements while aiming down sights, effectively eliminating scope sway for the marksman.
Rebalanced material construction removes the weapon's aim down sights moving accuracy penalty, but the wielder moves 33% slower while aiming.
A heavy barrel reduces cone of fire bloom by 20% while aiming down sights, but reduces aim down sights movement speed by 20%.

A single-shot shotgun round attachment; increases the equip time of the attached weapon by 0.25 seconds.

Pressing Gear Slot 1 hotkey will toggle the attachment.

Underbarrel smoke grenade launcher attachment; increases the equip time of the attached weapon by 0.25 seconds.

Pressing Gear Slot 1 hotkey will toggle the attachment.
Increases magazine size by 20 rounds by streamlining the ammunition placement and feeding, and slows your reload speed by 0.325 seconds.
Converts 20% of your weapon's total damage into a disrupting pulse that drains 0.4% of a target's maximum shield health and ability energy for every point of weapon damage converted.
A hybrid suppressor reduces weapon noise, muzzle flash, and prevents the player from showing on the minimap when firing, but bullet velocity is reduced by 20%.

The underbarrel Cure Launcher heals affected allies over time, and cleanses most status effects on impact. Equipping this attachment increases the equip time of the weapon by 0.25 seconds.

Pressing Gear Slot 1 hotkey will toggle the attachment.
Lashing Ammunition converts 40% of the weapon's direct damage into a small explosive blast on impact, but projectile velocity is reduced by 50%.
Unstable Ammunition significantly increases the size of projectiles fired while reducing headshot bonus damage by 80%.
Doubles the amount of ammunition in each magazine, and the weapon takes 20% longer to equip and unequip.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 10 rounds, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 1 round, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
Explosive Ammunition reduces the weapon's direct damage by 125, and adds 100 splash damage over 2 meters.
Manticore Ammunition reduces the movement speed of enemy infantry by 20% for 2 seconds, but reduces the weapon's projectile velocity by 40% at all times.
Replaces the default bolt with a heavier, explosive tipped variant that does moderate damage to MAX units and armored targets, reduces the number of shots in the magazine by one.
Replaces the default bolt with a low damage variant that includes a sensor device. The sensor can detect enemy movement within a limited range.
Replaces the default bolt with an incendiary variant that lights enemies within the impact area aflame.

A single-shot grenade launcher attachment; increases the equip time of the attached weapon by 0.25 seconds.

Pressing Gear Slot 1 hotkey will toggle the attachment.

An underbarrel high explosive grenade launcher.
Pressing Gear Slot 1 hotkey will toggle the attachment.
Bullets will now pierce through one infantry target before stopping, but reduces rate of fire by 10%.
Increases the weapon's minimum damage from 100 to 125, while reducing magazine size by 6.
Removes the speed penalty when reloading an empty magazine, but the weapon will recoil more harshly in one direction while firing.
Cerberus Ammunition divides the weapon's damage into three separate pellets that spread horizontally when fired from the hip, and vertically when fired while aiming.

The weapon's muzzle flash and noise generation is reduced, and the player no longer appears on the minimap when firing. In exchange, the weapon's damage falls off 10 meters sooner, and bullet velocity is reduced by 15%.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 3 rounds, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
Increases magazine size by 3 rounds, but increases hipfire cone of fire by 20%.
The supercooled coil allows the sniper to prepare another round while aiming down sights.
The weapon now fires an accurate, high-velocity slug dealing 650 damage, falling off to 500 at the weapon's minimum damage range.
Replaces the standard buckshot with dart-like flechettes that triple the maximum and minimum damage falloff range, but reduce the number of pellets fired per shot by 2.
Replaces the standard buckshot with dart-like flechettes that triple the maximum and minimum damage falloff range, but reduce the number of pellets fired per shot by 3.

An underbarrel smoke grenade grenade launcher.
Pressing Gear Slot 1 hotkey will toggle the attachment.

A compensator redirects gases upward, reducing vertical recoil by 30%. The increased sound pressure will cause the player to show on the minimap 35m farther away, and increased weapon bulk reduces hipfire cone of fire by 15%.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 50%, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
The hybrid laser reduces the weapon's hipfire cone of fire by 33% and hipfire pellet spread by 33%.
Increases projectile velocity by 25%, and reduces magazine size by 4.
An emission condenser reduces noise, muzzle flash, and prevents the player from showing on the minimap when firing, but bullet velocity is reduced by 20%.
This enhanced plasma containment modification suppresses visible light from the muzzle, but increases the range at which you appear on enemy minimaps by 15 meters.
Increases the weapon's minimum damage from 100 to 112, while reducing magazine size by 25.
Damage per bullet is increased to 350 within 10 meters, tapering to 334 at 20 meters, but this modification has heavy adverse effects on the weapon's recoil.
The number of infantry targets rounds can pierce through is no longer limited to 1, and will instead pierce through any number of targets. Sabot ammunition reduces rate of fire by 10%.
Allows for automatic firing from the hip and reduces hipfire cone of fire by 25%. When in this state, your rate of fire is also doubled and heat per shot and damage per bullet is cut in half.
Vertical recoil is reduced by 20%, and the weapon becomes semi-automatic, allowing for ease of handling at longer ranges.
Default
Increases projectile velocity by 25%, while reducing magazine size by 25.
Increases magazine size by 50 rounds by streamlining the ammunition placement and feeding, and slows your reload speed by 0.325 seconds.
Increases magazine size by 5 rounds by streamlining the ammunition placement and feeding, and slows your reload speed by 0.300 seconds.
Capsulate Ammunition splits the weapon's damage evenly among two pellets, reduces pellet spread by 75% from the hip and 50% while aiming down sights, and reduces magazine size by 4.
A stabilizing barrel reduces cone of fire bloom by 25%, while slowing the refire rate between each shot in a burst by roughly 7%.
While equipped, direct hits with the Thumper are capable of damaging heavy armor, but direct damage is also reduced by 50.
Enemies caught in the blast area will be ignited for 150 damage over 3 seconds, and blast damage on impact is reduced to 150.
Refined material construction removes the innate hipfire movement speed penalty, reduces the movement speed penalty while aiming by 50%, and increases the weapon's angular recoil by 33%.

Converts 20% of your weapon's direct damage into a disrupting area of effect pulse that drains 0.4% of an affected target's maximum shield health and ability energy for every point of the weapon's direct damage converted. Additionally, this disruption pulse deals high damage to small deployables.

This rail mounted zip light illuminates cloaked infiltrators and dark areas but the light can give away your position.

The light can be turned on and off with Toggle Attachment.
This high capacity battery increases the available shots per magazine by 3, but reduces rechamber speed by 25%.

The ACU syncs the underbarrel to the class equipping the weapon. This attachment can be active alongside other attachment types.

Infiltrator: EMP - Destroys deployables and scrambles HUD.
Light Assault: Impulse - Knocks back enemies and the wielder.
Medic: Cleanse - Heals and clears some status effects.
Engineer: Enhancement - Repairs and increases the maximum health of mechanical targets.
Heavy Assault: Havoc - Prevents mechanical targets from being repaired.
Increases the amount of ammunition in each magazine by 14 rounds, and the weapon takes 15% longer to equip and unequip.
A recoil stabilizer increases control of the weapon, reducing horizontal recoil by 25%, but increases equip time by 0.15 sec.
A burst stabilizer reduces the vertical recoil of the first shot in a burst by 60%, but increases the side to side recoil of a weapon by 10%.
Adds 50 additional rounds to each magazine, and the weapon takes 20% longer to equip and unequip.
